generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a specific class name to generate a mock for that class
generate_mock_virtual_methods: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual non-ctor/dtor methods in a C++ class header
generate_mock_templated_class: generate a templated Google Mock class from a C++ header with template type parameters
generate_mock_namespaced_class: generate a Google Mock class with proper namespace wrapping from a namespaced C++ header
